View and share the invitation

Registration is an expression of interest, not automatic membership or access. Each person registers directly, verifies their own email address and is reviewed by OPDA before onboarding.

We are not asking you to provide a member list. Please share the public registration link with people for whom it is relevant. Sharing the opportunity does not imply endorsement or partnership.

If another contact in your organisation is better placed to consider this request, please feel free to forward this message or reply to smartdata@openpropdata.org.uk.
